text: The n-th Postnikov section P_n(A) of a type A is characterized by:
choices: πₖ(P_n(A)) ≅ πₖ(A) for k ≤ n and πₖ(P_n(A)) = 0 for k > n
P_n(A) is the n-th loop space of A
P_n(A) is the n-fold suspension of A
P_n(A) has the same 0-cells as A but no higher cells
explanation: Postnikov sections truncate homotopy groups above n. P_n(A) is an n-type with a map A → P_n(A) inducing isomorphisms on πₖ for k≤n. These assemble into the Postnikov tower.
